page.layout: One printed page, framed by a woodcut ornamental border; one column of running text; no marginal notes. Running head at top centre, page number at top right. Signature at foot left of centre. The partial left-hand page edge with text is show-through or the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: tur. His paulò post subjicit: Qua-propter Saturnum non penitus reje-ceris, nec irrisoriè prorsus post tergũ collocaris: siquidem ejus natura & virtus non multis adhûc cognita est. Nam Philosophorum lapis primum suum initium sui cœlestis & plus-quam coruscantis coloris tantùm ex isto metallo habet, & per influenti-am hujus planetæ traditur ei clavis perseverantiæ per putrefactionem: quoniam ex citrino nullum potest fieri rubeum, nisi ex initio nigripri-us factum fuerit album. Hæc ille, quę ut altioris sunt indaginis, ita ad secretiorē Saturnum pertinere intelliguntur, nempe Philosophicũ, qui ex putrefactione existit Solis & salis Naturæ: tametsi inesse tum ipsi plumbi mineræ certi cujusdam generis, vim longè maximam cona-tur

page.notes: Running head "HELIANA" and page number 25 at top; signature "B 5" at foot. The catchword "tur" at the foot right repeats the first word of the next page. Some words in the first line are partly obscured by a stain near "tur". The left edge shows fragments of the facing page, not transcribed.
